theater: 希臘中部溫泉關與伊利里亞海岸

battle.name: 馬其頓戰爭
battle.theater: 希臘中部溫泉關與伊利里亞海岸
battle.brief: 公元前215年深秋，羅馬在得知腓力五世與漢尼拔結盟後正式宣戰，戰線由亞得里亞海的奧隆一路鋪到溫泉關、塞薩利與埃托利亞。卡面的亞述長矛是兩河流域九百年前的鐵器短柄長刃矛，並未在此役出現：馬其頓方用薩里沙長矛，埃托利亞輕步兵用標槍，羅馬軍用重標槍配大圓盾。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 這場戰爭是羅馬共和國與馬其頓王國在希臘世界的一場長期對峙，通常稱為第二次馬其頓戰爭；戰線的起點可上溯到公元前218年，羅馬正式宣戰則在公元前215年深秋。馬其頓一方由國王腓力五世直接統率，以馬其頓方陣步兵為核心，配備伙伴騎兵，並依賴三根外來支柱：斯巴達王阿基達穆斯三世與其弟埃烏達摩斯率領的斯巴達援軍、倒向馬其頓而非埃托利亞的各個希臘城邦，以及以哈斯德魯巴爾·巴爾卡為代表的迦太基方面的錢糧與器械。羅馬一方以執政官軍為骨幹，每年由兩名執政官各領一軍輪換出征，兵員來自羅馬公民步兵方陣與騎兵，並在希臘得到埃托利亞聯盟、阿該亞同盟、佩加蒙王國阿塔洛斯二世與伊庇魯王國的協助。戰場同時被拉成兩條線：亞得里亞海東岸的伊利里亞海岸線上，羅馬以艦隊和伊利里亞盟友為支點，爭奪港口城市奧隆、里梭斯與內陸銀礦山區；希臘本土線上，馬其頓聯盟與埃托利亞、阿該亞聯盟在溫泉關、塞薩利與科林斯地峽之間反覆拉鋸。站在中間還有一個不斷改換立場的第三方：伊庇魯王國起初袖手旁觀，後來倒向羅馬，成為羅馬在希臘的陸上基地與兵源之地。
countriesEn: This war was a long confrontation between the Roman Republic and the Kingdom of Macedon across the Greek world, generally called the Second Macedonian War; the front can be traced back to 218 BC, while Rome's formal declaration of war came in the late autumn of 215 BC. The Macedonian side was commanded directly by King Philip V, with the phalanx infantry as its core and the Companion cavalry in support, and it rested on three external props: a Spartan contingent under King Archidamus III and his brother Eudamus, the Greek cities that turned to Macedon rather than to Aetolia, and money, provisions and equipment from Carthage in the person of Hasdrubal Barca. The Roman side was built on the consular army, fielded in annual rotation by the two consuls, raised from Roman citizen infantry and cavalry, and reinforced inside Greece by the Aetolian League, the Achaean League, the Attalid kingdom of Pergamon under Attalus II, and the kingdom of Epirus. The theatre was pulled onto two axes at once. On the Illyrian shore of the eastern Adriatic Rome used its fleet and its Illyrian allies as footholds to contest the port towns of Aulon and Lissus and the inland silver districts; on the Greek mainland the Macedonian alliance and the Aetolian-Achaean coalition pulled back and forth over Thermopylae, Thessaly and the Isthmus of Corinth. A third party stood in the middle and kept changing sides: the kingdom of Epirus, which at first kept its hands off and later went over to Rome, thereby becoming Rome's land base and source of recruits inside Greece.
people: 腓力五世自公元前221年執政到前179年，是這條戰線的決策核心。他先後在希臘打贏共同戰爭，公元前217年以夜襲攻下溫泉關、打開通往玻俄提亞與阿提卡的道路，公元前214年在科魯庇翁擊敗埃托利亞與阿該亞的聯軍，隨後把兵鋒轉向伊利里亞，圍困奧隆與里梭斯，並靠迦太基的借款維持戰費與艦隊。羅馬方面的統帥是提多·昆克提奧斯·弗拉米尼諾斯：公元前218年他執政在西班牙打敗哈斯德魯巴爾，公元前213年再度執政並接手馬其頓戰線，前212年率艦隊進入亞得里亞海，前199年對埃托利亞同盟開戰，前197年在塞薩利擊敗腓力。伊利里亞方面的重要人物是首領斯凱爾迪拉伊達斯，他先與腓力合作，後來把里梭斯交給羅馬，改變了亞得里亞海的均勢。希臘城邦裡，阿該亞同盟的阿利斯多斯、埃托利亞聯盟的將領團與斯巴達的納比斯都捲入其中；被拖進這場糾葛的還有哲學家佩爾修斯，他是腓力的老師。而今天能留下這場戰爭細節的，是隨弗拉米尼諾斯出使希臘、後被留在羅馬作人質的歷史學家波利比奧斯。
peopleEn: Philip V, who ruled from 221 to 179 BC, was the decision centre on this front. He first won the Common War inside Greece, seized Thermopylae by a night attack in 217 BC to open the road into Boeotia and Attica, and beat an Aetolian-Achaean coalition at Corupium in 214 BC; he then swung his forces towards Illyria, besieging Aulon and Lissus, and kept the war supplied with Carthaginian loans and a fleet. The Roman commander was Titus Quinctius Flamininus: consul in 218 BC, he defeated Hasdrubal in Spain; consul again in 213 BC, he took over the Macedonian front and brought his fleet into the Adriatic in 212 BC; he opened war on the Aetolian League in 199 BC and defeated Philip in Thessaly in 197 BC. On the Illyrian side the key figure was the chieftain Scerdilaidas, who first worked with Philip and then handed Lissus over to Rome, shifting the balance of power in the Adriatic. Among the Greek actors, Aratus of Sicyon on the Achaean side, the strategoi of the Aetolian League and Nabis of Sparta were all drawn in; the philosopher Perseus of Cyrene, Philip's own teacher, was dragged into the entanglement as well. The reason we still possess the detailed record of this war is Polybius, who accompanied Flamininus on his mission to Greece and was afterwards kept as a hostage at Rome.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛屬於兩河流域的兵器傳統：短木柄、寬而長的鐵刃、鐵鏃，柄與刃之間以金屬箍結紮，刃面中央起脊而兩側開鋒，是亞述王軍在城頭與野外都會配發的標準近身兵器，通常與弓手混編使用。必須說清楚：這件兵器並沒有出現在公元前215年馬其頓與羅馬交手的戰場上，亞述王朝早已滅亡近四百年。此役真正在場的武器系統分屬兩大陣營。馬其頓方：步兵核心是薩里沙方陣，長逾五公尺的長矛以銀松木為柄、鐵矛頭，密集排列成數排深陣；兩翼配伙伴騎兵，人手一柄雙尖刺槍；步兵除長矛外還配短柄刺矛、小型圓盾與雙刃曲刀，投石手與弓手編在方陣之間。羅馬方：步兵以大圓盾與短劍為主，接戰前先以重標槍齊射，陣後有攜帶小盾的輕裝兵與役畜，攻城則靠撞錘、攻城塔與堆築的攻城土壘；騎兵用長刺槍，並改成並排衝鋒的會戰編制。埃托利亞與伊庇魯的輕步兵以標槍為主，配小圓盾與投石，正面對付密集方陣；伊利里亞人還駕小艇在沿岸峽灣活動，迦太基方面除提供金錢，還運來非洲象與全套攻城器材。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card belongs to the Mesopotamian weapon tradition: a short wooden shaft, a broad and long iron blade, an iron socket, the shaft bound to the blade with metal rings, the blade with a central ridge and two working edges. It was the standard close-combat arm of the Assyrian royal armies, on ramparts and in the field alike, and it was normally brigaded together with archers. It has to be said plainly: this weapon was not present on the battlefield in 215 BC, and the Assyrian dynasty had been gone for nearly four centuries. The weapon systems actually in the line belong to two great camps. On the Macedonian side the infantry core was the sarissa phalanx, spears over five metres long with silver-fir hafts and iron heads, ranked several files deep; the flanks were covered by the Companion cavalry, each rider with a two-pointed cavalry lance; the infantry also carried a short thrusting spear, a small round shield and a double-edged curved sword, with slingers and archers interspersed between the formations. On the Roman side the infantry fought with large round shields and short swords, opening with a volley of heavy javelins, supported behind by light-armed skirmishers with small shields and by draft animals; in the field they used the ram, the siege tower and the earthen siege mound, and their cavalry fought with long lances in a charge line. Aetolian and Epirote light infantry fought with javelins, small round shields and stones, going straight at the close-packed phalanx; the Illyrians moved along the coast in light craft, and the Carthaginian contribution was money, African elephants and the full set of siege equipment.
tactics: 馬其頓方陣的戰術核心是深度：薩里沙層層疊出，遠處的矛尖先與敵人接觸，羅馬方陣一被矛林擋住，拋石與重標槍便難以發揮。埃托利亞與伊庇魯的輕步兵靠丘陵掩護，用標槍從側面與正面高處襲擾方陣，這正是公元前197年塞薩利犬首山會戰的取勝關鍵：起伏地形把馬其頓方陣的正面與側翼拉成不同的接戰時序，羅馬縱隊以交替縱深接替作戰，埃托利亞標槍手同時壓住方陣的關節，缺口一開，羅馬騎兵與步兵便傾巢壓入。攻城方面，羅馬與伊庇魯的聯軍曾把土方工程直接堆到阿特拉克斯城牆根，攻下城池，這套辦法正是亞述人圍城時早已成熟的手段。海上，羅馬艦隊在亞得里亞海東岸與科基拉外海屢次攔截馬其頓分艦隊，切斷其與伊利里亞盟軍的聯繫。補給線是羅馬最吃力的環節：兵員與糧秣要由義大利的布倫迪西翁裝船，經亞得里亞海運到奧隆等基地，再靠陸路與沿岸小艇向前線輸送；冬季營地必須靠近村鎮與水源，腓力在伊利里亞的圍城戰因此屢屢因糧道與嚴寒而拖長。
tacticsEn: The core of Macedonian tactics was depth: the sarissas overlapped rank upon rank, so that the forward tips met the enemy first, and once a Roman formation was held off by that forest of points, the stone-throwers and heavy javelins lost their effect. Aetolian and Epirote light troops used the rolling ground for cover, harassing the phalanx with javelins from the flanks and from the high ground in front, and that was the key to the victory at the Dog's Heads in Thessaly in 197 BC. The broken terrain pulled the Macedonian front and flank into different rhythms of contact, the Romans fought in depth with relieving echelons, the Aetolian javelinmen pressed the joints of the phalanx at the same moment, and as soon as a gap opened the Roman cavalry and foot went in. In siege work the Roman-Epirote army once took Atrax by banking earth up against the foot of the wall, and that method of pushing earthworks directly against a wall was one the Assyrians had already mastered in their own sieges. At sea the Roman fleet repeatedly intercepted Macedonian squadrons off the eastern Adriatic and off Corcyra, cutting Macedon off from its Illyrian partners. Supply was Rome's weakest link: men and provisions were loaded at Brundisium in Italy and carried by sea to bases such as Aulon, then moved forward by road and by small coastal craft; winter camps had to be placed near villages and water, which is why Philip's Illyrian sieges were repeatedly prolonged by the length of his supply lines and by the cold.
data: 時間：這場戰爭自公元前218年算起，羅馬於公元前215年深秋正式宣戰，前201年以和約收束，前後約十七年，跨越羅馬的七次年度作戰。地理：戰線最西抵伊利里亞海岸的奧隆與里梭斯，最東到愛奧尼亞海的希俄斯島外海，東西跨度超過一千公里；希臘本土一段由溫泉關、埃托利亞、塞薩利到科林斯地峽，佩拉到溫泉關的行軍距離約三百五十公里。兵力：以塞薩利會戰為例，波利比奧斯記載雙方步兵各約二萬人，羅馬聯軍另有埃托利亞步兵六千、騎兵五百，腓力方面的騎兵約三千；羅馬每個年度作戰由兩名執政官各領一軍，合計約二萬步兵與數千騎兵。消耗與產能：遠征的開支主要靠同盟城市的徵收與伊利里亞銀礦的開採，前209年執政官盧基烏斯·安尼基烏斯·加盧斯攻下德爾米尼烏姆後，沿海各部族相繼歸順；迦太基對腓力的資助以借款形式出現，並帶來非洲象。至於精確傷亡，史料殘缺，只有塞薩利一役有波利比奧斯所記的概數：羅馬方面陣亡不足三百，腓力方面陣亡約八千、被俘五千餘人。
dataEn: Timing: counting from 218 BC, with the Roman declaration of war in the late autumn of 215 BC, the war was closed by a peace in 201 BC, about seventeen years in all, spanning seven Roman campaigning seasons. Geography: the westernmost point was the Illyrian coast at Aulon and Lissus, the easternmost the waters off Chios in the Aegean, a span of more than a thousand kilometres; within the Greek mainland the line ran from Thermopylae through Aetolia and Thessaly to the Isthmus of Corinth, and the marching distance from Pella to Thermopylae is about three hundred and fifty kilometres. Numbers: at the Thessalian battle Polybius records roughly twenty thousand foot on each side, the Roman side having in addition six thousand Aetolian foot and five hundred Aetolian horse, while Philip's cavalry numbered about three thousand; each Roman year brought two consular armies, about twenty thousand foot and several thousand horse between them. Cost and productivity: the campaign was paid for chiefly by levies from the allied cities and by the silver of the Illyrian mines, and after the praetor Lucius Anicius Gallus took Delminium in 209 BC the coastal tribes submitted in turn; Carthaginian aid to Philip came in the form of loans, and brought African elephants with it. On exact casualties the record is thin, and only the Thessalian battle carries a Polybian summary: fewer than three hundred Roman dead, and on Philip's side about eight thousand dead and more than five thousand captured.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。第一層是迦太基與羅馬的框架：公元前226年的艾布羅條約劃定了伊比利亞半島的勢力界線，公元前215年冬，漢尼拔的弟弟哈斯德魯巴爾·巴爾卡與腓力五世在伊庇魯接洽，並在科林斯地峽的朱庇特神廟內由迦太基使節見證，簽訂同盟條約，條文裡甚至寫明腓力可以率軍加入意大利戰場，把戰火引向意大利。羅馬一旦得知，立刻在公元前215年深秋向腓力宣戰，等於把希臘戰線與意大利戰線綁在一起。第二層是羅馬在亞得里亞海的直接利益：伊利里亞的銀礦與港口是羅馬自伊利里亞戰爭以來就盯上的資源，腓力的海軍加上伊利里亞盟軍封住了通往希臘的航路，羅馬必須保住自己的收入與航線。第三層是馬其頓自己的擴張計劃：腓力剛在希臘打贏共同戰爭，又想插手意大利的事務，於是奪取伊利里亞沿岸據點、插手科西嘉與希臘之間的航路，把兩片海域連成一體。背景還有亞歷山大大帝的遠征傳統與泛希臘同盟的口號：把希臘城邦統一於王權之下是爭取貢賦與聯盟的說法，真正的關鍵始終是港口、銀礦與羅馬在希臘的影響力。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason behind the fighting. The first was the frame set by Carthage and Rome: the Treaty of the Ebro of 226 BC drew the line in Iberia, and in the winter of 215 BC Hasdrubal Barca, Hannibal's brother, made contact with Philip V in Epirus, and inside the temple of Jupiter at the Isthmus of Corinth, with Carthaginian envoys witnessing, a treaty of alliance was signed whose text even provided that Philip might bring his army into Italy and turn the war on that front. Once Rome learned of it, war was declared on Philip in the late autumn of 215 BC, welding the Greek front to the Italian one. The second layer was Rome's direct interest in the Adriatic: the Illyrian silver and harbours were resources Rome had coveted since the Illyrian wars, and Philip's navy together with his Illyrian allies closed the sea lane to Greece, so Rome had to protect its revenue and its route. The third layer was Macedon's own programme of expansion: fresh from winning the Common War in Greece, Philip wanted a hand in Italian affairs, and he took the Illyrian coastal strongpoints and the sea lanes between Corsica and Greece, linking two seas into one. Behind all this lay the memory of Alexander's expedition and the talk of a Panhellenic league: uniting the Greek cities under a kingship was a formula for tribute and alliance, but the real stakes were always harbours, silver and Roman influence in Greece.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果，是羅馬把手伸進了希臘世界。公元前196年，弗拉米尼諾斯在科林斯地峽的伊斯特米亞運動會上宣布希臘各城邦自由，形式上解散了馬其頓的聯盟統治；然而所謂自由很快變成各城邦自行組成的聯盟與羅馬的駐軍保護，埃托利亞聯盟隨即在公元前199年挑起對羅馬的戰爭，慘敗之後元氣大傷，公元前167年被解散；伊庇魯則因皮洛士的野心捲入新的麻煩，前167年羅馬平掉伊庇魯的聯盟，把全境劃為行省，國王與大批人口被賣為奴隸。對馬其頓本身，這十七年耗盡了國力：腓力五世失去希臘的盟邦與伊利里亞的基地，前201年和約之後又交出人質、賠付巨款並交出一半的非洲象，王國從此退守巴爾幹。從長期看，這場戰爭開啟了羅馬地中海政策的主線：分化、以聯盟與人質控制被征服者、前146年摧毀科林斯的貿易與同盟體系，然後在公元前148年把馬其頓王國本身劃為行省。希臘城市在殘破中換來一時的自治，卻也從此綁上羅馬的戰車，龐培的清洗便是二十多年後的收尾。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was that Rome reached into the Greek world. In 196 BC Flamininus proclaimed the freedom of the Greek cities at the Isthmian Games at Corinth, formally dissolving the league rule of Macedon; but that freedom soon turned into new regional leagues under Roman protection, the Aetolian League picked a fight with Rome in 199 BC and was so badly beaten that it was dissolved in 167 BC, and Epirus, dragged in by the ambitions of Pyrrhus, had its federal league broken up by Rome in 167 BC, the whole country turned into a province, with the king and large numbers of the population sold into slavery. For Macedon itself the seventeen years drained the state: Philip V lost his Greek allies and his Illyrian base, and the peace of 201 BC cost him hostages, a heavy indemnity and half his elephants, after which the kingdom withdrew into the Balkans. In the long run the war opened the main line of Roman Mediterranean policy: divide, control the conquered through alliances and hostages, break the Corinthian trade and league system in 146 BC, and then in 148 BC reduce the kingdom of Macedon itself to a province. The Greek cities bought a measure of autonomy at the price of ruin, and were from then on hitched to the Roman war-wagon, with Pompey's purge arriving two decades later as the closing scene.
result: 打到最後是羅馬贏了。公元前197年，弗拉米尼諾斯在塞薩利犬首山以埃托利亞標槍手與羅馬縱隊的配合擊敗腓力五世，迫使腓力求和；公元前201年，羅馬艦隊在希俄斯島外海擊毀馬其頓分艦隊，隨後的圍城戰失利，雙方在伊利里亞線上達成和約：腓力放棄在希臘的盟友，撤走各地駐軍，賠付巨款，把長子佩爾修斯與次子德米特里亞斯送往羅馬作人質，並依約交出一半的非洲象。馬其頓王國保住了王位與本土，卻失去希臘，國力大損；羅馬沒有佔領馬其頓，而是用聯盟與人質的辦法把它綁住，這種以聯盟治理代替直接統治的做法，成為之後一百年羅馬對希臘的政策範本。腓力五世於公元前182年去世，繼位的佩爾修斯在第三次馬其頓戰爭中與羅馬正面衝突，公元前168年的皮德納之戰之後，公元前148年馬其頓被正式劃為行省，亞歷山大大帝留下的國家在立國六個半世紀後徹底消失。
resultEn: It ended with Rome on top. In 197 BC Flamininus beat Philip V at the Dog's Heads in Thessaly, with Aetolian javelinmen and Roman echelons working together, and Philip had to ask for terms; in 201 BC, after the Roman fleet destroyed the Macedonian squadrons off Chios and the siege that followed went against Macedon, the two sides made peace on the Illyrian line: Philip gave up his allies in Greece, withdrew his garrisons, paid a heavy indemnity, sent his elder son Perseus and his second son Demetrius to Rome as hostages, and handed over half his African elephants as the treaty required. The kingdom of Macedon kept its king and its homeland but lost Greece and was badly drained; Rome did not annex it, preferring to bind it with alliances and hostages, and that preference for ruling through leagues rather than direct conquest became the template of Roman policy in Greece for the next century. Philip V died in 182 BC; his son Perseus came into open conflict with Rome in the Third Macedonian War, and after Pydna in 168 BC the kingdom was made a province in 148 BC, six and a half centuries after the state founded by Alexander ceased to exist.
